text:
# ChatGPT 的推荐依据远不止 Reddit

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-08-21 00:28（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2090475967328190709
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

我认为，围绕 Reddit 的这一整套玩法，最大的错误是：人们想当然地认为，ChatGPT 在决定推荐什么之前，只会看 Reddit。

但现实是：它并不是这样。

如果你只输入“最好的某某”这样的提示词……这大多是一种想象出来的提问方式。

人们在 Google 上搜索东西，却会与 ChatGPT 一起推理、研究，而且会提供多得多的背景信息。

以本地商家为例。

它会考虑：

- 你的背景信息，例如你是谁、处境、所在地等。

- 你打算聘用的商家所拥有的许可证，例如法律、建筑等行业的资质。

- 商会名录和类似信息。

- 能找到的大型聚合平台上的评论。

- “最佳”榜单文章等。

- 你自己的网站，质量必须过关。

人们基本上是在把钱扔给 Reddit 代理机构，而不是从整体上关注自己的业务。

别误会，Reddit 和其他社交媒体一样，能帮助销售！但这并不意味着它每次都一定能为你带来引用。

## 英文原文

I think the biggest mistake with the whole Reddit thing is people are taking for granted that ChatGPT only looks at it before deciding what to recommend.

But the reality is: it doesn't.

If you prompt alone for "Best blabla"... that's mostly a fantasy way of prompting.

People SEARCH in Google for things, but they REASON with ChatGPT to research. And there's a lot more context.

Take for example a local business. 

It considers:

- Your context (who you are, situation, localization, etc.)

- Licenses of the business you're looking to hire (legal, construction, etc.)

- Chamber of commerce listings and similar 

- Reviews across big aggregators where possible

- "Best" listicles, etc.

- Your own website (needs to be good)

People are basically throwing their money away on Reddit agencies instead of focusing on their businesses as a whole. 

Don't get me wrong, Reddit works to sell as any other social media! But it doesn't mean every time it'll surely get you a citation.
